description: Search the Immigration Services Agency of Japan registry of Registered Support Organizations for Specified Skilled Workers. Filter by name, location (prefecture/city in head office or support office address) and supported language. Organizations that reported suspension are excluded unless includeSuspended is true. 出入国在留管理庁「登録支援機関登録簿」から、特定技能外国人の登録支援機関を名称・所在地・対応言語で検索します（同梱データ・基準日あり）。

includeSuspended.description: Include organizations that reported suspension / 支援業務休止の届出がある機関も含める

language.description: Supported language in Japanese / 対応言語（例：ベトナム語、英語）

limit.description: Max results (default 10, max 20) / 最大件数

location.description: Prefecture or city, partial match on address / 所在地（例：東京都、横浜市。住所の部分一致）

name.description: Organization name, partial match / 名称（部分一致）

name: search_support_orgs
title: Search Japanese registered support organizations (SSW)
